title: 12 Best Spots to Sip Butter Coffee with Annapurna Sunrise Views in Pokhara
description: Discover the top 12 lakeside cafes in Pokhara, Nepal, offering breathtaking views of the Annapurna range reflected in Phewa Lake as you sip butter coffee before sunrise. Perfect for photographers and early birds.
category: Spots to Sip Butter Coffee with Annapurna Sunrise Views

places.name: Freedom Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their strong Nepali coffee (ask for butter to be added for a custom butter coffee) and a Tibetan Bread.

places.name: Byanjan Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A custom butter coffee with their premium espresso, paired with a flaky croissant or their local breakfast set.

places.name: The Coffee Shop
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A strong Americano or Espresso (request butter) and any of their freshly baked pastries.

places.name: Boomerang Restaurant & Lakeside Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A strong Black Coffee (ask for butter) and their Everest Breakfast, a hearty way to start your day.

places.name: White Rabbit Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their Americano (customize with butter) and a plate of their fresh fruit with yogurt.

places.name: German Bakery Pokhara
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A strong filter coffee (request butter) and a fresh apple strudel or chocolate croissant.

places.name: Little Windows Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their ginger lemon honey tea or a strong black coffee (ask for butter) with an order of their homemade momos.

places.name: Fresh Elements
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their organic coffee (request butter) and a healthy breakfast bowl or avocado toast.

places.name: Dali Cafe Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their strong Espresso (with butter if desired) and a slice of their homemade cake or a savory breakfast item.

places.name: Dragon's Den Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their classic Filter Coffee (ask for butter) and a plate of their authentic Tibetan bread with honey.

places.name: Moonlight Cafe & Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order An Americano or Cappuccino (customizable with butter) and their Pancake with fresh fruit.

places.name: Cafe Evoke
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their signature Evoke Blend coffee (ask for butter) and a delightful cinnamon roll or their vegetarian breakfast plate.
